words.gloss: in the equal calamity of the neighbouring chiefs
the one to be marched against
the one to be marched against

hindi: पड़ोसी सामन्तों के समान व्यसन में “जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो, या अमित्र?” — अमित्र पर चढ़ाई करे; उसकी सिद्धि होने पर जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो।
english: In the equal calamity of the neighbouring chiefs, ‘the one to be marched against, or the enemy?’ — [one] should march against the enemy; on the success of that, [against] the one to be marched against.
notes: Compound tulya-sāmanta-vyasane is ambiguous (equal calamity of the neighbouring chiefs; or 'when neighbouring chiefs are equal in calamity'). sāmanta = neighbouring chief. yātavya (gerundive of √yā) = the one to be marched against, not in the glossary: rendered literally. The verb of the last clause is elided (repeats abhiyāyāt); English supplies it in brackets, Hindi leaves it unstated. The iti after the alternative closes it as a question and is not rendered.
lines_deva: तुल्य.सामन्त.व्यसने यातव्यम् अमित्रं वा-इत्य् अमित्रम् अभियायात्, तत्.सिद्धौ यातव्यम्
lines_iast: tulya.sāmanta.vyasane yātavyam amitraṃ vā-ity amitram abhiyāyāt, tat.siddhau yātavyam

words.gloss: on the success of the enemy
the one to be marched against
on the success of the one to be marched against

hindi: क्योंकि अमित्र की सिद्धि होने पर जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो, सहायता दे; अमित्र नहीं, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो उसकी सिद्धि होने पर।
english: For, on the success of the enemy, the one to be marched against may give assistance; not the enemy, on the success of the one to be marched against.
notes: amitra-siddhau / yātavya-siddhau: literally 'in the success of the enemy / of the one to be marched against'; the sense is probably success of the operation against him, the alternative being the success of that party itself. Gloss 'success regarding' keeps both open. The verb 'give assistance' is not repeated in the last clause (elided). Review: gloss and English now read literally 'success of'; the reading 'success of the operation against him' stays in this note only.
lines_deva: अमित्र.सिद्धौ हि यातव्यः साहाय्यं दद्यान् न-अमित्रो यातव्य.सिद्धौ
lines_iast: amitra.siddhau hi yātavyaḥ sāhāyyaṃ dadyān na-amitro yātavya.siddhau

words.gloss: the one to be marched against

hindi: “जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो, भारी व्यसन वाला, या हल्के व्यसन वाला अमित्र?” — “भारी व्यसन वाले पर सरलता से चढ़ाई करे,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: ‘The one to be marched against who has a heavy calamity, or the enemy who has a light calamity?’ — “[One] should march against the one with a heavy calamity, from ease,” say the teachers.
notes: The first part is the question put by the teachers' school; only the second part is in the quotation marks of the e-text, kept as printed. ācāryāḥ = the teachers (glossary). saukaryataḥ = from ease (ease of the undertaking).
lines_deva: गुरु.व्यसनं यातव्यं लघु.व्यसनम् अमित्रं वा-इति "गुरु.व्यसनं सौकर्यतो यायाद्" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: guru.vyasanaṃ yātavyaṃ laghu.vyasanam amitraṃ vā-iti "guru.vyasanaṃ saukaryato yāyād" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: हल्के व्यसन वाले अमित्र पर चढ़ाई करे।
english: [One] should march against the enemy who has a light calamity.
lines_deva: लघु.व्यसनम् अमित्रं यायात्
lines_iast: laghu.vyasanam amitraṃ yāyāt

hindi: क्योंकि हल्का भी व्यसन जिस पर आक्रमण किया गया हो उसके लिए कठिन होता है।
english: For even a light calamity becomes grievous to one who is attacked.
notes: laghv = laghu (sandhi u+a). abhiyuktasya is a genitive: 'of/for one attacked'. kṛcchra = grievous, hard.
lines_deva: लघ्व् अपि हि व्यसनम् अभियुक्तस्य कृच्छ्रं भवति
lines_iast: laghv api hi vyasanam abhiyuktasya kṛcchraṃ bhavati

words.gram: ind. (n. acc. sg. used as adv.)

hindi: सचमुच भारी भी अधिक भारी होता है।
english: Truly, even a heavy [calamity] becomes heavier.
notes: gurv = guru (sandhi). The noun vyasanam is understood from unit 6; English brackets it, Hindi leaves it unstated.
lines_deva: सत्यं गुर्व् अपि गुरुतरं भवति
lines_iast: satyaṃ gurv api gurutaraṃ bhavati

words.gloss: the one to be marched against

hindi: किन्तु आक्रमण न किया गया, हल्के व्यसन वाला अमित्र सरलता से व्यसन का प्रतिकार करके जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी हो उसकी ओर बढ़े, या पार्ष्णि पकड़ ले।
english: But the enemy who is not attacked and has a light calamity, having easily remedied the calamity, may advance against the one to be marched against, or may seize the heel.
notes: pārṣṇim grah = seize the heel (glossary, image kept). pratikṛtya-amitro: pratikṛtya + amitraḥ. abhisaret read as 'advance against' (alternative: 'attack').
lines_deva: अनभियुक्तस् तु लघु.व्यसनः सुखेन व्यसनं प्रतिकृत्य-अमित्रो यातव्यम् अभिसरेत्, पार्ष्णिं वा गृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: anabhiyuktas tu laghu.vyasanaḥ sukhena vyasanaṃ pratikṛtya-amitro yātavyam abhisaret, pārṣṇiṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: in the simultaneity of ones to be marched against

hindi: जिन पर चढ़ाई करनी हो उनके एक साथ होने पर “भारी व्यसन वाला, न्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला; हल्के व्यसन वाला, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला; या विरक्त प्रकृतियों वाला?” — विरक्त प्रकृतियों वाले पर चढ़ाई करे।
english: In the simultaneity of those to be marched against: ‘the one with a heavy calamity [and] of just conduct, the one with a light calamity [and] of unjust conduct, or the one with disaffected constituent elements?’ — [one] should march against the one with disaffected constituent elements.
notes: yaugapadya = simultaneity (several at once). The three candidates are separated by the English '[and]' only to show the pairs; vṛtti = conduct. prakṛti = constituent element (glossary); virakta = disaffected.
lines_deva: यातव्य.यौगपद्ये गुरु.व्यसनं न्याय.वृत्तिं लघु.व्यसनम् अन्याय.वृत्तिं विरक्त.प्रकृतिं वा-इति विरक्त.प्रकृतिं यायात्
lines_iast: yātavya.yaugapadye guru.vyasanaṃ nyāya.vṛttiṃ laghu.vyasanam anyāya.vṛttiṃ virakta.prakṛtiṃ vā-iti virakta.prakṛtiṃ yāyāt

hindi: भारी व्यसन वाले, न्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाले, आक्रमण किए गए का प्रकृतियाँ साथ देती हैं; हल्के व्यसन वाले, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाले की उपेक्षा करती हैं; विरक्त प्रकृतियाँ बलवान् को भी उच्छिन्न कर देती हैं।
english: The constituent elements support the one with a heavy calamity [and] of just conduct who is attacked; they neglect the one with a light calamity [and] of unjust conduct; the disaffected [ones] cut off even the strong one.
notes: prakṛtayo 'nugṛhṇanti = prakṛtayaḥ anugṛhṇanti. 'Cut off' renders ud-√chid literally (uproot, destroy).
lines_deva: गुरु.व्यसनं न्याय.वृत्तिम् अभियुक्तं प्रकृतयो ऽनुगृह्णन्ति, लघु.व्यसनम् अन्याय.वृत्तिम् उपेक्षन्ते, विरक्ता बलवन्तम् अप्य् उच्छिन्दन्ति
lines_iast: guru.vyasanaṃ nyāya.vṛttim abhiyuktaṃ prakṛtayo 'nugṛhṇanti, laghu.vyasanam anyāya.vṛttim upekṣante, viraktā balavantam apy ucchindanti

hindi: इसलिए विरक्त प्रकृतियों वाले पर ही चढ़ाई करे।
english: Therefore [one] should march only against the one with disaffected constituent elements.
lines_deva: तस्माद् विरक्त.प्रकृतिम् एव यायात्
lines_iast: tasmād virakta.prakṛtim eva yāyāt

words.gloss: having diminished and greedy constituent elements
having diminished and greedy constituent elements
to be accomplished by restraining the chiefs

hindi: “‘क्षीण और लुब्ध प्रकृतियों वाला, या अपचरित प्रकृतियों वाला?’ — क्षीण और लुब्ध प्रकृतियों वाले पर चढ़ाई करे, क्योंकि क्षीण और लुब्ध प्रकृतियाँ सरलता से उपजाप या पीड़ा को प्राप्त होती हैं; अपचरित नहीं, प्रधानों को रोकने से साध्य।” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “‘The one with diminished and greedy constituent elements, or the one with wronged constituent elements?’ — [one] should march against the one with diminished and greedy constituent elements; for diminished and greedy constituent elements easily come to secret instigation or affliction; not the wronged ones — [they are] to be accomplished by restraining the chiefs,” say the teachers.

text_flags.why: possible: the quotation is closed after sādhyāḥ but no opening quotation mark is printed in this unit (unit 11 is Kautilya's own statement, so the quote does not continue from it)

notes: apacarita (ppp. apa-√car) is rendered 'wronged'; the alternative is 'gone wrong / misbehaving', and the sense is doubtful. kṣīṇa = diminished (impoverished in the sense of the commentators, in notes only). Construction of 'na apacaritāḥ pradhāna-avagraha-sādhyāḥ' is uncertain: na may negate the preceding verb ('the wronged ones do not easily come to instigation or affliction; they are to be accomplished by restraining the chiefs'). Kept literal. Hindi has the outer quotation closing only because the e-text does (no opening printed). Review: English 'wronged' and Hindi अपचरित (kept as the term) differ; the sense (wronged / gone wrong, glossary 4.12 'go wrong') is a person's decision. The closing quote has no opening mark in the e-text; the flag stands (opening before kṣīṇa, since units 9-11 are Kautilya's own statement).
lines_deva: क्षीण.लुब्ध.प्रकृतिम् अपचरित.प्रकृतिं वा-इति क्षीण.लुब्ध.प्रकृतिं यायात्, क्षीण.लुब्धा हि प्रकृतयः सुखेन-उपजापं पीडां वा-उपगच्छन्ति, न-अपचरिताः प्रधान.अवग्रह.साध्याः" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: kṣīṇa.lubdha.prakṛtim apacarita.prakṛtiṃ vā-iti kṣīṇa.lubdha.prakṛtiṃ yāyāt, kṣīṇa.lubdhā hi prakṛtayaḥ sukhena-upajāpaṃ pīḍāṃ vā-upagacchanti, na-apacaritāḥ pradhāna.avagraha.sādhyāḥ" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः
lines_iast: na-iti kauṭilyaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि क्षीण और लुब्ध प्रकृतियाँ भर्ता के प्रति स्नेही भर्ता के हित में स्थित रहती हैं, या उपजाप को विफल करती हैं; अनुराग में सर्वगुणता है।
english: For diminished and greedy constituent elements, attached to the master, stand in the master's welfare, or they frustrate the secret instigation; in attachment [there is] possession of all good qualities.
notes: visaṃvādayanti: caus., 'make fail / cause to disagree', rendered 'frustrate'. The closing iti has no opening quotation and is not rendered. bhartṛ = master (glossary does not fix it; kept distinct from svāmin = king).
lines_deva: क्षीण.लुब्धा हि प्रकृतयो भर्तरि स्निग्धा भर्तृ.हिते तिष्ठन्ति, उपजापं वा विसंवादयन्ति, अनुरागे सार्वगुण्यम् इति
lines_iast: kṣīṇa.lubdhā hi prakṛtayo bhartari snigdhā bhartṛ.hite tiṣṭhanti, upajāpaṃ vā visaṃvādayanti, anurāge sārvaguṇyam iti

hindi: इसलिए अपचरित प्रकृतियों वाले पर ही चढ़ाई करे।
english: Therefore [one] should march only against the one with wronged constituent elements.
notes: See unit 12 on apacarita.
lines_deva: तस्माद् अपचरित.प्रकृतिम् एव यायात्
lines_iast: tasmād apacarita.prakṛtim eva yāyāt

hindi: “बलवान्, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला, या दुर्बल, न्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला?” — बलवान्, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाले पर चढ़ाई करे।
english: ‘The strong one of unjust conduct, or the weak one of just conduct?’ — [one] should march against the strong one of unjust conduct.
lines_deva: बलवन्तम् अन्याय.वृत्तिं दुर्बलं वा न्याय.वृत्तिम् इति बलवन्तम् अन्याय.वृत्तिं यायात्
lines_iast: balavantam anyāya.vṛttiṃ durbalaṃ vā nyāya.vṛttim iti balavantam anyāya.vṛttiṃ yāyāt

hindi: बलवान्, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाले, आक्रमण किए गए का प्रकृतियाँ साथ नहीं देतीं; निकाल देती हैं, या उसके अमित्र का आश्रय लेती हैं।
english: The constituent elements do not support the strong one of unjust conduct who is attacked; they make [him] fall out, or they resort to his enemy.
notes: niṣpātayanti is literally 'cause to fall out' (eject, drive out); the object is not stated.
lines_deva: बलवन्तम् अन्याय.वृत्तिम् अभियुक्तं प्रकृतयो न-अनुगृह्णन्ति, निष्पातयन्ति, अमित्रं वा-अस्य भजन्ते
lines_iast: balavantam anyāya.vṛttim abhiyuktaṃ prakṛtayo na-anugṛhṇanti, niṣpātayanti, amitraṃ vā-asya bhajante

hindi: किन्तु दुर्बल, न्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाले, आक्रमण किए गए को प्रकृतियाँ अपनाती हैं, या पीछे-पीछे निकल पड़ती हैं।
english: But the constituent elements embrace the weak one of just conduct who is attacked, or go out after [him].
notes: parigṛhṇanti: 'take up, embrace, adopt'. anuniṣpatanti: 'go out after' (follow out / rally); the object is unstated.
lines_deva: दुर्बलं तु न्याय.वृत्तिम् अभियुक्तं प्रकृतयः परिगृह्णन्ति, अनुनिष्पतन्ति वा
lines_iast: durbalaṃ tu nyāya.vṛttim abhiyuktaṃ prakṛtayaḥ parigṛhṇanti, anuniṣpatanti vā

hindi: क्योंकि सज्जनों के अपमान और असज्जनों के प्रग्रह से, और अभूतपूर्व, धर्म-विरुद्ध हिंसाओं के प्रवर्तन से,
english: For through contempt of the good and favouring of the bad, and through the setting in motion of unprecedented, unlawful acts of violence,
notes: The sentence runs on through units 20 to 26 (verb upajāyate in unit 26: loss, greed and disaffection arise). pragraha = favouring (as asat-pragraha, glossary); alternative 'taking hold of'. abhūta literally 'not been' (unprecedented); alternatives 'unreal, unfounded'. adharmya = contrary to dharma, 'unlawful'. avakṣepa = contempt, rejection.
lines_deva: अवक्षेपेण हि सताम् असतां प्रग्रहेण च
अभूतानां च हिंसानाम् अधर्म्याणां प्रवर्तनैः
lines_iast: avakṣepeṇa hi satām asatāṃ pragraheṇa ca
abhūtānāṃ ca hiṃsānām adharmyāṇāṃ pravartanaiḥ

hindi: उचित, अत्यन्त धर्मिष्ठ आचरणों को रोकने से, अधर्म की आसक्ति से और धर्म को रोकने से,
english: by stopping the customary, most righteous practices, by indulgence in unrighteousness, and by restraint of dharma,
notes: ucita = fitting, customary. prasaṅga = attachment, indulgence. avagraha = obstruction, restraint. adharma = unrighteousness (glossary).
lines_deva: उचितानां चरित्राणां धर्मिष्ठानां निवर्तनैः
अधर्मस्य प्रसङ्गेन धर्मस्य-अवग्रहेण च
lines_iast: ucitānāṃ caritrāṇāṃ dharmiṣṭhānāṃ nivartanaiḥ
adharmasya prasaṅgena dharmasya-avagraheṇa ca

words.gloss: of what is not to be done
of what is to be done
of what is to be given
of what is not to be given

hindi: न करने योग्य के करने और करने योग्य के नाश से, देने योग्य के न देने और न देने योग्य के साधन से,
english: both by doing what is not to be done and by destroying what is to be done, both by not giving what is to be given and by accomplishing what is not to be given,
notes: Each pair 'X ca ... Y ca' is a 'both ... and' pair. sādhanaiḥ is literally 'accomplishings' (procuring, exacting); sense uncertain.
lines_deva: अकार्याणां च करणैः कार्याणां च प्रणाशनैः
अप्रदानैश् च देयानाम् अदेयानां च साधनैः
lines_iast: akāryāṇāṃ ca karaṇaiḥ kāryāṇāṃ ca praṇāśanaiḥ
apradānaiś ca deyānām adeyānāṃ ca sādhanaiḥ

words.gloss: of those not liable to penalty
of those not to be seized

hindi: दण्ड के योग्यों को दण्ड न देने और दण्ड के अयोग्यों को दण्ड देने से, न पकड़ने योग्यों के पकड़ने और पकड़ने योग्यों को न पकड़ने से,
english: both by not penalizing those liable to penalty and by penalizing those not liable to penalty, by seizing those not to be seized and by not seizing those to be seized,
notes: daṇḍa = penalty (coercion of persons; Book 3/4 rendering). upagrāha is taken as 'seizure' (alternative 'support, favour', as upagraha elsewhere); grāhya/agrāhya could also mean 'to be accepted/not to be accepted'. The ca after grāhyāṇām links this line to the preceding.
lines_deva: अदण्डनैश् च दण्ड्यानाम् अदण्ड्यानां च दण्डनैः
अग्राह्याणाम् उपग्राहैर् ग्राह्याणां च-अनभिग्रहैः
lines_iast: adaṇḍanaiś ca daṇḍyānām adaṇḍyānāṃ ca daṇḍanaiḥ
agrāhyāṇām upagrāhair grāhyāṇāṃ ca-anabhigrahaiḥ

hindi: निरर्थक के करने और सार्थक के विघात से, चोरों से रक्षा न करने और स्वयं लूटने से,
english: both by doing the worthless and by destroying the worthwhile, both by non-protection from thieves and by robbing [them] oneself,
notes: anarthya = worthless (glossary 5.4); arthya taken as its opposite, 'worthwhile' (glossary gives 'petitioners', doubtful, for 5.4.10 only). Alternative: 'those with a purpose / petitioners'. The object of parimoṣaṇa is not stated.
lines_deva: अनर्थ्यानां च करणैर् अर्थ्यानां च विघातनैः
अरक्षणैश् च चोरेभ्यः स्वयं च परिमोषणैः
lines_iast: anarthyānāṃ ca karaṇair arthyānāṃ ca vighātanaiḥ
arakṣaṇaiś ca corebhyaḥ svayaṃ ca parimoṣaṇaiḥ

hindi: पुरुषकारों के पतन से, कर्मों के गुणों को दूषित करने से, प्रधानों के उपघात से और माननीयों के अपमान से,
english: by the fall of human efforts, by the spoiling of the merits of actions, by injuries to the chiefs, and by insults to the honoured,
notes: puruṣa-kāra = human effort, literally 'man-doing'. guṇa-dūṣaṇa = spoiling of merits/qualities of actions (karma = action). pradhāna = chief.
lines_deva: पातैः पुरुष.काराणां कर्मणां गुण.दूषणैः
उपघातैः प्रधानानां मान्यानां च-अवमाननैः
lines_iast: pātaiḥ puruṣa.kārāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ guṇa.dūṣaṇaiḥ
upaghātaiḥ pradhānānāṃ mānyānāṃ ca-avamānanaiḥ

hindi: और वृद्धों के विरोध से, वैषम्य और असत्य से, किए हुए का प्रतिकार न करने से और तय हुए को न करने से,
english: and by antagonizing the elders, by unevenness and falsehood, by non-requital of what has been done, and by not doing what is settled,
notes: vaiṣamya = unevenness, partiality (injustice). sthita = what is established or settled (a settled rule/promise); sense uncertain. The first ca links the line to the preceding units of the same sentence.
lines_deva: विरोधनैश् च वृद्धानां वैषम्येण-अनृतेन च
कृतस्य-अप्रतिकारेण स्थितस्य-अकरणेन च
lines_iast: virodhanaiś ca vṛddhānāṃ vaiṣamyeṇa-anṛtena ca
kṛtasya-apratikāreṇa sthitasya-akaraṇena ca

words.gloss: by the destruction of acquisition and security

hindi: राजा के प्रमाद और आलस्य से, या योग और क्षेम के नाश से, प्रकृतियों का क्षय, लोभ और विरक्ति उत्पन्न होते हैं।
english: through the king's negligence and laziness, or through the destruction of acquisition and security, loss, greed and disaffection of the constituent elements arise.
notes: End of the sentence begun in unit 19. The verb upajāyate is singular for three subjects. yoga = acquisition, kṣema = security (glossary 6.2). kṣaya = loss (glossary 9.4). vairāgya here means disaffection (Hindi विरक्ति, not the ascetic sense).
lines_deva: राज्ञः प्रमाद.आलस्याभ्यां योग.क्षेम.वधेन वा
प्रकृतीनां क्षयो लोभो वैराग्यं च-उपजायते
lines_iast: rājñaḥ pramāda.ālasyābhyāṃ yoga.kṣema.vadhena vā
prakṛtīnāṃ kṣayo lobho vairāgyaṃ ca-upajāyate

hindi: क्षीण प्रकृतियाँ लोभ को पहुँचती हैं, लुब्ध विरक्ति को; विरक्त — या अमित्र के पास जाती हैं, या स्वयं भर्ता को मार डालती हैं।
english: The diminished constituent elements go to greed, the greedy go to disaffection; the disaffected either go to the enemy or themselves kill the master.
notes: virāgatā = disaffection-ness. Both vā are rendered 'or'.
lines_deva: क्षीणाः प्रकृतयो लोभं लुब्धा यान्ति विरागताम्
विरक्ता यान्त्य् अमित्रं वा भर्तारं घ्नन्ति वा स्वयम्
lines_iast: kṣīṇāḥ prakṛtayo lobhaṃ lubdhā yānti virāgatām
viraktā yānty amitraṃ vā bhartāraṃ ghnanti vā svayam

words.gloss: causes of loss, greed and disaffection
words.gram: n. acc. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: इसलिए प्रकृतियों के क्षय, लोभ, विरक्ति के कारणों को उत्पन्न न करे, या उत्पन्न हुए का तुरन्त प्रतिकार करे।
english: Therefore [one] should not produce the causes of loss, greed and disaffection of the constituent elements, or should at once remedy those that have arisen.
notes: Hindi lists the three members of the dvandva with commas only (glossary 3.15 rule).
lines_deva: तस्मात् प्रकृतीनां क्षय.लोभ.विराग.कारणानि न-उत्पादयेत्, उत्पन्नानि वा सद्यः प्रतिकुर्वीत
lines_iast: tasmāt prakṛtīnāṃ kṣaya.lobha.virāga.kāraṇāni na-utpādayet, utpannāni vā sadyaḥ pratikurvīta

hindi: ये क्षीण, लुब्ध या विरक्त प्रकृतियाँ हैं।
english: Such [are] the diminished, greedy or disaffected constituent elements.
notes: Heading-like line introducing units 30-32, which treat the three kinds in turn; iti is glossed 'closing particle' and rendered as 'Such [are]' on the pattern of the glossary's closing labels.
lines_deva: क्षीणा लुब्धा विरक्ता वा प्रकृतय इति
lines_iast: kṣīṇā lubdhā viraktā vā prakṛtaya iti

words.gloss: from fear of affliction and uprooting

hindi: क्षीण, पीड़न और उच्छेदन के भय से तुरन्त सन्धि, युद्ध या बाहर निकल जाने को पसन्द करते हैं।
english: The diminished, from fear of affliction and uprooting, at once prefer peace, battle or going out.
notes: niṣpatana, literally 'falling/going out', is doubtful here (sally, flight, desertion); kept literal. sandhi = peace (glossary 8.5); ucchedana = uprooting, destruction.
lines_deva: क्षीणाः पीडन.उच्छेदन.भयात् सद्यः सन्धिं युद्धं निष्पतनं वा रोचयन्ते
lines_iast: kṣīṇāḥ pīḍana.ucchedana.bhayāt sadyaḥ sandhiṃ yuddhaṃ niṣpatanaṃ vā rocayante

words.gloss: the secret instigation of the other

hindi: लुब्ध, लोभ से असन्तुष्ट, दूसरे के उपजाप को पाना चाहते हैं।
english: The greedy, dissatisfied through greed, seek the secret instigation of the other.
notes: para = the other (enemy); upajāpa = secret instigation. 'lobhena asantuṣṭāḥ' could also be 'dissatisfied through [their] greed'.
lines_deva: लुब्धा लोभेन-असन्तुष्टाः पर.उपजापं लिप्सन्ते
lines_iast: lubdhā lobhena-asantuṣṭāḥ para.upajāpaṃ lipsante

hindi: विरक्त दूसरे के अभियोग की ओर उठ खड़े होते हैं।
english: The disaffected rise up towards the attack of the other.
notes: abhi-ud-√sthā with accusative: 'rise towards / rise to meet or support'. Sense (rise in support of the attack, or to meet it) uncertain. abhiyoga = attack.
lines_deva: विरक्ताः पर.अभियोगम् अभ्युत्तिष्ठन्ते
lines_iast: viraktāḥ para.abhiyogam abhyuttiṣṭhante

words.gram: m. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

words.gloss: loss of yugya (those fit for the yoke) and men
words.gram: m. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

words.gloss: to be accomplished by money and grain

hindi: उनमें धन और धान्य का क्षय सबका उपघात करने वाला और कठिन प्रतिकार वाला है; युग्य और पुरुषों का क्षय धन और धान्य से साध्य है।
english: Of them, the loss of money and grain injures all and is hard to remedy; the loss of yugya (those fit for the yoke) and men is to be accomplished by money and grain.
notes: hiraṇya = money (glossary 5.2). yugya literally 'fit for the yoke' (draught animals or vehicles); doubtful, kept as 'yoke-animals' in English and yugya in Hindi. kṣaya = loss.
lines_deva: तासां हिरण्य.धान्य.क्षयः सर्व.उपघाती कृच्छ्र.प्रतीकारश् च, युग्य.पुरुष.क्षयो हिरण्य.धान्य.साध्यः
lines_iast: tāsāṃ hiraṇya.dhānya.kṣayaḥ sarva.upaghātī kṛcchra.pratīkāraś ca, yugya.puruṣa.kṣayo hiraṇya.dhānya.sādhyaḥ

words.gloss: in the interests of the other

hindi: लोभ एकदेशीय है, मुख्यों पर निर्भर है; दूसरे के प्रयोजनों में प्रतिहत करना या ग्रहण करना सम्भव है।
english: Greed is partial [and] dependent on the chiefs; in the interests of the other it is possible to counter [it] or to take [it] up.
notes: para-artheṣu is doubtful (in the aims / affairs / interests of the other; alternatively 'in the wealth of others'). pratihantum 'to counter, strike back'; ādātum 'to take up, seize'; the object is greed. Sense of the whole doubtful.
lines_deva: लोभ ऐकदेशिको मुख्य.आयत्तः पर.अर्थेषु शक्यः प्रतिहन्तुम् आदातुं वा
lines_iast: lobha aikadeśiko mukhya.āyattaḥ para.artheṣu śakyaḥ pratihantum ādātuṃ vā

words.gloss: to be accomplished by restraining the chief

hindi: विरक्ति प्रधान को रोकने से साध्य है।
english: Disaffection is to be accomplished by restraining the chief.
notes: avagraha = restraint, obstruction (glossary 5.6, avagrāhayet = have restrained). pradhāna may be singular or generic.
lines_deva: विरागः प्रधान.अवग्रह.साध्यः
lines_iast: virāgaḥ pradhāna.avagraha.sādhyaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि प्रधान-रहित प्रकृतियाँ भोग्य होती हैं और दूसरों के उपजाप के योग्य नहीं होतीं, किन्तु आपत्ति सहने में असमर्थ।
english: For constituent elements without a chief become fit to be used and not open to the secret instigation of others, but [they are] not bearing adversity.
notes: bhogya = to be enjoyed or used (exploitable); cf. glossary 3.8, bhoga = use. 'anyeṣām' is a genitive of the agent after anupajāpyāḥ. anāpat.sahāḥ is read an-āpad-sahāḥ: not able to bear adversity (āpad = adversity, glossary 8.1). The final clause has no verb.
lines_deva: निष्प्रधाना हि प्रकृतयो भोग्या भवन्त्य् अनुपजाप्याश् च-अन्येषाम्, अनापत्.सहास् तु
lines_iast: niṣpradhānā hi prakṛtayo bhogyā bhavanty anupajāpyāś ca-anyeṣām, anāpat.sahās tu

words.gloss: by the favouring of the chiefs of the constituent elements

hindi: किन्तु प्रकृतियों के मुख्यों के प्रग्रह से अनेक प्रकार से टूटी हुई, सुरक्षित और आपत्ति सहने वाली होती हैं।
english: But through the favouring of the chiefs of the constituent elements, [they] become broken in many ways, protected, and bearing adversity.
notes: Subject (prakṛtayaḥ of unit 36) not restated. pragraha = favouring (as asat-pragraha, glossary 8.3); alternative 'taking hold of, restraining'. bhinna = split: possibly 'though split'; the Sanskrit has no concessive word. Sense doubtful.
lines_deva: प्रकृति.मुख्य.प्रग्रहैस् तु बहुधा भिन्ना गुप्ता भवन्त्य् आपत्.सहाश् च
lines_iast: prakṛti.mukhya.pragrahais tu bahudhā bhinnā guptā bhavanty āpat.sahāś ca

words.gram: n. acc. pl., tat-puruṣa with dvandva

hindi: सामवायिकों के भी सन्धि और विग्रह के कारणों पर विचार करके शक्ति और शुचिता से युक्तों के साथ मिलकर चढ़ाई करे।
english: Having considered the causes of peace and war even of the associates, [one] should march in combination with those endowed with power and purity.
notes: sāmavāyika = associate (one who joins in a combined undertaking; samavāya = association, glossary 3.1). sandhi = peace (8.5), vigraha = war. śauca = purity, integrity. sambhūya 'having combined', i.e. jointly.
lines_deva: सामवायिकानाम् अपि सन्धि.विग्रह.कारणान्य् अवेक्ष्य शक्ति.शौच.युक्तैः सम्भूय यायात्
lines_iast: sāmavāyikānām api sandhi.vigraha.kāraṇāny avekṣya śakti.śauca.yuktaiḥ sambhūya yāyāt

words.gloss: in giving assistance for the march

hindi: क्योंकि शक्तिमान् पार्ष्णि पकड़ने में या यात्रा में सहायता देने में समर्थ है; शुचि सिद्धि में और असिद्धि में जैसा तय हुआ वैसा करने वाला है।
english: For the powerful one is able in seizing the heel or in giving assistance for the march; the pure one acts as settled both in success and in failure.
notes: The token 'yathā.sthita.kārī-iti' is printed with a '-' join: kārī + iti. iti closes the statement and is not rendered. yathā-sthita = as settled (as agreed); yātrā = march (glossary 9.1).
lines_deva: शक्तिमान् हि पार्ष्णि.ग्रहणे यात्रा.साहाय्य.दाने वा शक्तः, शुचिः सिद्धौ च-असिद्धौ च यथा.स्थित.कारी-इति
lines_iast: śaktimān hi pārṣṇi.grahaṇe yātrā.sāhāyya.dāne vā śaktaḥ, śuciḥ siddhau ca-asiddhau ca yathā.sthita.kārī-iti

words.gloss: a march is to be made

hindi: “उनमें एक श्रेष्ठ के साथ या दो समानों के साथ मिलकर चढ़ाई करनी चाहिए?” — दो समानों के साथ श्रेयस्कर है।
english: ‘Among them, a march is to be made in combination with one superior or with two equals?’ — with two equals [it is] better.
notes: jyāyas = the superior (greater). yātavyam is impersonal here ('a march is to be made'), not the noun yātavya of the preceding units. The question is closed by iti and answered in the last clause.
lines_deva: तेषां ज्यायसा-एकेन द्वाभ्यां समाभ्यां वा सम्भूय यातव्यम् इति द्वाभ्यां समाभ्यां श्रेयः
lines_iast: teṣāṃ jyāyasā-ekena dvābhyāṃ samābhyāṃ vā sambhūya yātavyam iti dvābhyāṃ samābhyāṃ śreyaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि श्रेष्ठ से रोका हुआ चलता है, या दो समानों के द्वारा छल की अधिकता होने पर।
english: For, restrained by the superior, [one] goes about; or, [when there is] an excess of outwitting by two equals.
notes: The second clause is elliptical (the verb and the participle avagṛhīta are understood). atisandhāna = outwitting (glossary 9.1); ādhikya = excess, superiority. Sense of 'carati' (goes about, acts, behaves) and of the whole is uncertain.
lines_deva: ज्यायसा ह्य् अवगृहीतश् चरति, समाभ्याम् अतिसन्धान.आधिक्ये वा
lines_iast: jyāyasā hy avagṛhītaś carati, samābhyām atisandhāna.ādhikye vā

hindi: क्योंकि वे दोनों भेद कराने में सरल हैं; और दुष्ट एक का दो के द्वारा नियन्त्रण, और भेद और सहारे का आश्रय लेना।
english: For those two are easy to cause to split; and a single corrupt one [is easy] to restrain by two, and to resort to dissension and support.
notes: bheda-upagraham: compound doubtful (dvandva 'dissension and support' or tat-puruṣa 'support by dissension'); upagraha = support (glossary 11.1 upagṛhya). The adjective 'easy' is understood with the last clauses (English brackets it; Hindi leaves it unstated). iti closes the reasoning and is not rendered. The e-text writes 'ca-eko', 'ca-upagantum' with a '-' join of two words each.
lines_deva: तौ हि सुखौ भेदयितुम्, दुष्टश् च-एको द्वाभ्यां नियन्तुं भेद.उपग्रहं च-उपगन्तुम् इति
lines_iast: tau hi sukhau bhedayitum, duṣṭaś ca-eko dvābhyāṃ niyantuṃ bheda.upagrahaṃ ca-upagantum iti

hindi: “एक समान के साथ, या दो हीनों के साथ?” — दो हीनों के साथ श्रेयस्कर है।
english: ‘[With] one equal, or with two inferiors?’ — with two inferiors [it is] better.
notes: Elliptical (sambhūya yātavyam understood from unit 40). The token 'samena-ekena' is a '-' join of two words.
lines_deva: समेन-एकेन द्वाभ्यां हीनाभ्यां वा-इति द्वाभ्यां हीनाभ्यां श्रेयः
lines_iast: samena-ekena dvābhyāṃ hīnābhyāṃ vā-iti dvābhyāṃ hīnābhyāṃ śreyaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि वे दोनों दो कार्यों को साधने वाले और वश में रहने वाले होते हैं।
english: For those two become accomplishers of two tasks and controllable.
notes: dvi-kārya-sādhaka is obscure ('accomplishing a double task'; 'two tasks' or 'a twofold task'). vaśya = under control.
lines_deva: तौ हि द्वि.कार्य.साधकौ वश्यौ च भवतः
lines_iast: tau hi dvi.kārya.sādhakau vaśyau ca bhavataḥ

words.gloss: on the success of the task
from one whose object is accomplished

hindi: किन्तु कार्य की सिद्धि होने पर कृतार्थ श्रेष्ठ से छिपा हुआ बहाने के साथ खिसक जाए; अशुचि से; किन्तु शुद्ध आचरण वाले से विसर्जन तक प्रतीक्षा करे।
english: But on the success of the task, [one], concealed, should slip away with a pretext from the superior whose object is accomplished; [one should slip away] from the impure; but from one of pure conduct [one] should wait until dismissal.

text_flags.why: possible: a stray dash between 'tu' and 'kṛta.arthāj' that carries no word; it may be the editors' pause mark

notes: The second line is elliptical: the verb apasravet is understood with aśuceḥ (English brackets it, Hindi leaves it unstated). gūḍha here is the adjective 'concealed', not the agent class of the glossary. apasravet is literally 'flow away'. The '-' token is a lone dash; in the words it is entered as punctuation. Sense of the contrast doubtful.
lines_deva: कार्य.सिद्धौ तु - कृत.अर्थाज् ज्यायसो गूढः स.अपदेशम् अपस्रवेत्
अशुचेः शुचि.वृत्तात् तु प्रतीक्षेत-आ विसर्जनात्
lines_iast: kārya.siddhau tu - kṛta.arthāj jyāyaso gūḍhaḥ sa.apadeśam apasravet
aśuceḥ śuci.vṛttāt tu pratīkṣeta-ā visarjanāt

words.gloss: from one who has obtained his object
first part of viśvastasya (separated by a stray space)
second part of viśvastasya: 'of one who trusts'

hindi: सत्त्र से सावधान हट जाए, या कलत्र को हटाकर। क्योंकि विश्वास करने वाले को प्रयोजन पा चुके समान से भी भय हो सकता है।
english: [One] should withdraw from the sattra, on guard, or having removed the household. For fear would arise for one who trusts even from an equal who has obtained his object.

text_flags.why: possible: a stray space; 'viśvas tasya' does not parse, 'viśvastasya' (ppp. vi-√śvas, gen. sg., 'of one who trusts') does

notes: sattra is left untranslated: glossary has both 'hiding-place, ambush position' (8.5) and 'sacrificial session' (5.6); sense here uncertain. kalatram: the glossary has 'royal household' (10.2); whose household is not stated. yattaḥ: 'on guard, careful'. Review: sattra kept untranslated in both languages; the 5.6 'sacrificial session' sense does not fit a withdrawal from allies, the 8.5 'hiding-place' sense is possible, a person decides. kalatra = the household as in 10.2, 'royal' not added because the owner is not stated.
lines_deva: सत्त्राद् अपसरेद् यत्तः कलत्रम् अपनीय वा
समाद् अपि हि लब्ध.अर्थाद् विश्वस् तस्य भयं भवेत्
lines_iast: sattrād apasared yattaḥ kalatram apanīya vā
samād api hi labdha.arthād viśvas tasya bhayaṃ bhavet

words.gloss: one who has obtained his object

words.gram: 3 sg. pres. pass. or mid. pari-√kḷp

hindi: श्रेष्ठता में और भी प्रयोजन पाया हुआ समान भी परिकल्पित होता है; और उन्नत अविश्वसनीय है; वृद्धि चित्त में विकार उत्पन्न करने वाली है।
english: And also in superiority, one who has obtained his object, even an equal, is reckoned; and the one risen high is not to be trusted; growth alters the mind.
notes: Line 1 is obscure: jyāyastve 'in superiority' is possibly 'as a superior' and parikalpate 'is conceived/regarded/supposed' (e.g. 'is regarded as superior, even if equal'). Rendered literally; low confidence. abhyuccita = risen high, exalted.
lines_deva: ज्यायस्त्वे च-अपि लब्ध.अर्थः समो ऽपि परिकल्पते
अभ्युच्चितश् च-अविश्वास्यो वृद्धिश् चित्त.विकारिणी
lines_iast: jyāyastve ca-api labdha.arthaḥ samo 'pi parikalpate
abhyuccitaś ca-aviśvāsyo vṛddhiś citta.vikāriṇī

hindi: श्रेष्ठ से थोड़ा भी अंश पाकर सन्तुष्ट मुख वाला चला जाए; या अंश-रहित, तब उसके अंक में प्रहार करके दुगुना ले ले।
english: Having obtained even a small share from the superior, [one] should depart with a satisfied face; or, without a share, then, having struck in his aṅka, [one] should take double.
notes: aṅka (lap, side, mark) is obscure in 'asya aṅke prahṛtya' and left untranslated; 'having struck him in the lap/side' is one reading. haret: 'take away, take'; dvi-guṇam 'twofold'. The e-text prints 'viśiṣṭād alpam apy aṃśaṃ' and 'tato 'sya-aṅke' with a '-' join. Low confidence.
lines_deva: विशिष्टाद् अल्पम् अप्य् अंशं लब्ध्वा तुष्ट.मुखो व्रजेत्
अनंशो वा ततो ऽस्य-अङ्के प्रहृत्य द्वि.गुणं हरेत्
lines_iast: viśiṣṭād alpam apy aṃśaṃ labdhvā tuṣṭa.mukho vrajet
anaṃśo vā tato 'sya-aṅke prahṛtya dvi.guṇaṃ haret

hindi: किन्तु कृतार्थ नेता स्वयं सामवायिकों को विदा करे; हार भी जाए, जीते नहीं; उस प्रकार मण्डल का इष्ट हो।
english: But the leader himself, whose object is accomplished, should dismiss the associates; [one] might even be defeated, [but] should not win; in that way [he] would be desired by the circle.
notes: 'api jīyeta na jayet': one reading is 'he may even be defeated by them but should not defeat them' (the object is not stated); jīyeta from √ji passive (or √jyā 'lose'). maṇḍala = circle (glossary); iṣṭa = desired, liked. Medium-low confidence.
lines_deva: कृत.अर्थस् तु स्वयं नेता विसृजेत् सामवायिकान्
अपि जीयेत न जयेन् मण्डल.इष्टस् तथा भवेत्
lines_iast: kṛta.arthas tu svayaṃ netā visṛjet sāmavāyikān
api jīyeta na jayen maṇḍala.iṣṭas tathā bhavet
